infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Commute Ping uses location during an active commute to show route progress and, only for a connected shared commute, send progress to accepted trusted contacts.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: During a shared commute, Commute Ping uses background location so accepted trusted contacts can continue seeing journey progress after you lock the phone. Sharing stops when you end the commute.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Commute Ping reads motion sensors during an active commute to detect possible falls or phone snatches on this device. A confirmed trigger may open a visible emergency evidence screen; it never places calls automatically.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Commute Ping uses foreground location during an active commute to show progress on this device.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: During a shared commute, Commute Ping uses background location so accepted trusted contacts can continue seeing journey progress after you lock the phone. Sharing stops when you end the commute.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Commute Ping to access your contacts so you can choose a trusted contact. Selected details stay on this device and no invitation is sent.

plugins.motionPermission: Commute Ping reads motion sensors during an active commute to detect possible falls or phone snatches on this device. A confirmed trigger may open a visible emergency evidence screen; it never places calls automatically.

plugins.cameraPermission: Commute Ping uses the camera in a visible foreground emergency evidence screen after manual SOS or a confirmed safety trigger.
plugins.microphonePermission: Commute Ping uses the microphone for video audio in a visible foreground emergency evidence screen.
